path_step: System redirects the Staff to Dashboard Page based on role.
test_scenario: Verification of successful login redirecting a Teacher to their role-specific dashboard.
test_case_title: Successful Teacher Login Redirects to Teacher Dashboard
pre_condition: A valid Teacher account exists and the system is online.
expected_result: Teacher is authenticated and redirected to the Teacher-specific Dashboard.
post_condition: Teacher is logged in and on the Teacher Dashboard.

test_steps.step: Enter valid Teacher username/email and password.
Verify redirection to the Teacher-specific Dashboard.

uncovered_conditions: BR-LOGIN-02: Role-Based Access Control (explicit verification of teacher dashboard redirection)
